versions.content: {DRAFT} For Synchronized and a Pure Local Time Base if • Time Validation is enabled • and the Fallback Virtual Local Time is valid (i.e., StbM_GetFallback- VirtualLocalTime returns E_OK ), • and the Primary Virtual Local Time is valid (i.e., StbM_GetCurrentVir- tualLocalTime returns E_OK ), when the StbM is about to update the Main Time Tuple for the Time Base (refer to [SWS_StbM_00433]) then the StbM shall in that order 1. save the current Main Time Triple of the Time Base as the previous Main Time Triple [TL Main(prev) , TV Main(prev) , TV Fallback_Main(prev) ] 2. update the current Main Time Tuple of the Time Base (refer to [SWS_StbM_00433])
